legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 says an unmarked root is legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE and must not be rewritten.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal step 1 rejects any trailing planning-mode value other than upfront or incremental before any scratch or vault write, while superauthor A1 forbids code execution.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal step 4 requires every newly authored incremental root to persist the exact Planning mode marker incremental.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent filenames with a stated preparation method, but S3 requires a current PREPARED receipt before execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture or other foundational choices without a bounded discovery contract and classifies unbounded foundational uncertainty as invalid.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires the provider PR merged into authoritative main plus tracked delivery evidence, so an open PR neither satisfies S02 nor permits C9 completion.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 and supertraverse C9 say a provider disposition closes only its own obligation and cannot satisfy a live consumer until an adopted replan removes or replaces the contract.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies a dependency cycle in the active upfront graph as BLOCKED before selection.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S2 requires every active scope row to have a readable Plan link and supertraverse C6 forbids filling an upfront publication gap through incremental authoring.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: Superstage S1/S2 allow the mapped scratch tree to pass candidate validation with three unique leaves, but candidate state and Preparation none cannot authorize execution under S1/S3.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal steps 6-7 preserve an interrupted reviewed upfront tree in its scratch index as DRAFT-INCOMPLETE until confirmation, with no vault publication or execution.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal's resume contract reuses the matching scratch set, destination, and stable IDs without allocating duplicates, but re-applies the still-unsatisfied confirmation gate.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal's resume contract requires an explicitly revised scratch draft when the source digest changes and otherwise preserves the old draft as DRAFT-INCOMPLETE without execution.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal step 7 says a declined human gate preserves the scratch index, reports DRAFT-INCOMPLETE, and performs no vault write or code execution.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta step 6 preserves and reports an explicit DRAFT-INCOMPLETE index, writes nothing to the iteration ledger, and exits absent verified complete publication evidence.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns bounded file, helper, and test-detail changes that preserve every commitment to refine under PLAN_REFINER.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 assigns an unavoidable shared-contract behavior change affecting consumers to structural replan under REPLANNER.

preparation_noop.reason: Superstage S5 classifies first receipt attachment with no plan-body change as amendment none and keeps the Stage revision unchanged.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: Superstage S4/S5 permits evidence-grounded bounded executable detail changes as a content amendment, preserving commitments while incrementing the Stage revision.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: Superrefine and superstage S4 require REPLAN-REQUIRED when evidence expands approved scope, preserving the approved leaf rather than overwriting it in place.

source_revision_changed.reason: Superstage S4/S5 treats a changed authoritative acceptance condition and source-revision mismatch as REPLAN-REQUIRED, invalidating executability without an in-place rewrite.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: Superstage S5 requires a focused compatible-baseline revalidation receipt for an unrelated HEAD advance while preserving both commitments and Stage revision.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: Superstage S4/S5 classifies a consumed contract's behavioral semantic-revision change as REPLAN-REQUIRED, so the old consumer is non-executable and cannot be overwritten in place.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: Supertraverse C6 and superrun step 1 return NEEDS-REFINEMENT for the first eligible upfront leaf missing a preparation receipt and prohibit EXECUTOR from running code.

partially_executed_stage.reason: Superstage S3 and superrefine's entry gate route an already-started stage through execution or CI recovery and forbid in-place preparation over its task history.

manual_superrun_pending_batch.reason: Superstage S1 makes Active replan a durable execution barrier, so superrun must return BLOCKED before implementation or merge despite the older preparation.

execution_snapshot_historical_digest.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 and supertraverse C7 require the execution-entry snapshot and verify H2 against the historical V4 prepared-plan blob rather than the closeout-annotated current file.

merged_lost_closeout_response.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 reuses one authoritative matching delivery receipt and linked tree history after a lost response, avoiding duplicate publication or code execution.

ci_pending_replan_request.reason: Superagent's CI resume reconciliation and superloop L6 require the committed pending batch to pause the whole goal, preserve PR evidence, and return to WAITING FOR PLAN without merging green CI.

impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 keeps a purely internal S02 detail change under PLAN_REFINER and says such a change creates no structural batch or whole-goal barrier.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: Superstage S4 revises S02 and S03, stops propagation at S03's preserved C-S03@2 output, retains unaffected unfinished S04 and S05, and preserves delivered S01 as completed history.

impact_foundational_change.reason: Superstage S4 expands beyond the initial dependent closure when shared foundational evidence invalidates S04 too, revises every unfinished stage, and keeps delivered S01 as completed history with no preserved boundary.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 requires the tracked decision record and root Active replan pointer to be committed together before REPLANNER dispatch, while a loop-log-only adoption keeps execution paused.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 says an authoritative pending request with no unique draft continues by dispatching superreplan while its whole-goal execution barrier remains active.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: Supertraverse C8 resumes one unique Decision-ID-bound scratch batch as a draft while the pending Active replan barrier keeps execution paused and no vault publication exists.
